score_explanation: Fox Valley Physical Therapy & Wellness Clinic has zero citations across all five AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overview, and AI Mode. Despite a 34-year operating history, strong patient reviews, and listings on several local directories, the domain has not been picked up by any AI-powered search surface. The clinic's digital footprint is largely confined to its own website and a small number of local review platforms, with no presence on high-authority third-party sources that AI engines rely on for citation decisions. No tracking prompts have been configured yet, so per-prompt opportunity remains unmeasured.

whats_working.title: Established Local Reputation with Positive Sentiment
whats_working.detail: The clinic holds 5-star ratings on Google, Yelp, Yahoo Local, and Yellow Pages, with an 88% recommendation rate on Facebook across 25 reviews. Patient testimonials describe exceptional outcomes, including a case where a surgeon called the recovery 'the most phenomenal result in 27 years of practice.' This positive sentiment is a foundation that can be leveraged to build AI-visible authority.

whats_working.title: Unique Differentiator — Therapeutic Pool
whats_working.detail: Fox Valley Physical Therapy is described as the only private practice in the Oshkosh area offering a therapeutic pool. This is a concrete, citable differentiator that AI engines can surface when answering queries about aquatic therapy or specialized physical therapy in the region.

whats_working.title: Long Operating History and Specialized Services
whats_working.detail: Established in 1990 with over 100 years of combined staff experience, the clinic offers McKenzie Method spine care, dry needling, TMJ treatment, aquatic therapy, and post-operative rehabilitation. This breadth of specialized services creates multiple keyword clusters that could attract AI citations if properly structured and published.

holding_back.title: Zero Citations Across All AI Engines
holding_back.detail: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overview, and AI Mode all show zero citations for this domain. The clinic has no measurable AI search visibility, meaning it is not being surfaced in response to any relevant queries on any of these platforms.

holding_back.title: No Presence on High-Authority Third-Party Platforms
holding_back.detail: The domain has no listings or mentions on platforms that AI engines heavily weight, such as Healthgrades, Zocdoc, WebMD provider directory, US News Health, or local health journalism outlets. Review volume on Google (7 reviews) is very low, limiting the signal strength that Gemini and AI Overview draw from.

holding_back.title: Thin Content Footprint for AI Indexation
holding_back.detail: The website has a blog section, but there is no evidence of structured FAQ pages, condition-specific landing pages, or detailed service documentation that Perplexity and AI Overview favor when pulling citations. Without rich, structured content, the site cannot compete for informational query coverage.

holding_back.title: No Schema Markup or Knowledge Graph Presence Detected
holding_back.detail: There is no confirmed schema markup (e.g., MedicalBusiness, FAQPage, or LocalBusiness structured data) and no Knowledge Graph entry detected. Gemini and Google AI Overview rely heavily on these signals to identify and cite local healthcare providers.

holding_back.title: No Tracking Prompts Configured
holding_back.detail: Zero prompts are currently being tracked across all five engines. Without prompt tracking, there is no way to measure which queries represent the highest citation opportunity or to monitor improvement over time as optimizations are made.

recommendations.title: Implement LocalBusiness and MedicalBusiness Schema Markup
recommendations.description: Add structured data (JSON-LD) to the homepage and key service pages using Schema.org MedicalBusiness and LocalBusiness types. Include name, address, phone, hours, geo coordinates, services offered, and aggregate rating. This is the single highest-impact action for Gemini and Google AI Overview, both of which draw heavily from structured data and Google's Knowledge Graph. Submit the site to Google Search Console and request indexation after schema is added.

recommendations.title: Build a Google Business Profile and Increase Google Review Volume
recommendations.description: With only 7 Google reviews, the clinic's local authority signal is very weak. Actively solicit reviews from satisfied patients via follow-up emails or in-clinic prompts. A target of 50+ Google reviews with detailed text (mentioning specific treatments like aquatic therapy or dry needling) will significantly improve Gemini and AI Overview citation likelihood. Ensure the Google Business Profile is fully completed with photos, services, and Q&A populated.

recommendations.title: Create Structured FAQ and Condition-Specific Content Pages
recommendations.description: Perplexity and AI Overview aggressively pull from FAQ-structured content. Build dedicated pages for top conditions treated (herniated disc, post-surgical rehab, TMJ, sports injuries) and add FAQPage schema to each. Create a standalone FAQ page answering questions like 'What is the McKenzie Method?', 'Does insurance cover aquatic therapy?', and 'What makes one-on-one physical therapy different?' This content directly targets informational queries where AI engines cite sources.

recommendations.title: Configure Tracking Prompts in AIRT
recommendations.description: Zero prompts are currently tracked, making it impossible to measure AI visibility progress. Set up tracking prompts covering the clinic's core keyword clusters: 'best physical therapy in Oshkosh WI', 'aquatic therapy near Oshkosh', 'one-on-one physical therapy Wisconsin', 'McKenzie Method physical therapist', and 'dry needling Oshkosh'. This will establish a baseline and reveal which engines and query types offer the fastest citation opportunity.

recommendations.title: Claim and Optimize Listings on Health-Specific Directories
recommendations.description: AI engines — especially ChatGPT and Perplexity — frequently cite Healthgrades, Zocdoc, WebMD provider directory, and Psychology Today (for OT). Claim and fully complete profiles on Healthgrades and WebMD's provider directory at minimum. These platforms are high-authority sources that AI engines treat as credible third-party signals for healthcare providers.

recommendations.title: Publish Authoritative Blog Content Targeting AI-Cited Queries
recommendations.description: The site has a blog but content depth is unclear. Publish long-form articles (800–1,500 words) on topics like 'Aquatic Therapy vs. Land-Based Physical Therapy: Which Is Right for You?', 'How the McKenzie Method Treats Herniated Discs', and 'What to Expect After Knee Replacement Surgery: A PT Guide'. These comparison and educational formats are heavily favored by Perplexity and ChatGPT for citation.

recommendations.title: Pursue Local Press and Health Publication Mentions
recommendations.description: Seek mentions in Oshkosh-area news outlets (Oshkosh Northwestern), Wisconsin health blogs, or regional 'best of' lists. A single mention in a credible local publication can serve as a third-party citation signal that AI engines pick up. The clinic's 34-year history and unique therapeutic pool are strong story angles for local journalists.

recommendations.title: Add Video Content and Optimize for Knowledge Graph
recommendations.description: Create a YouTube channel with short videos demonstrating aquatic therapy, dry needling, and McKenzie Method exercises. YouTube content is indexed by Google and can contribute to Knowledge Graph entity recognition. Tag videos with the clinic's name, location, and service terms consistently to reinforce entity association across Google's systems, which benefits Gemini and AI Overview.

checklist_items.title: Add LocalBusiness / MedicalBusiness JSON-LD Schema to Homepage
checklist_items.description: Implement structured data markup including name, address, phone, hours, geo coordinates, services, and aggregate rating. Validate with Google's Rich Results Test before publishing.

checklist_items.title: Claim and Complete Google Business Profile
checklist_items.description: Ensure the Google Business Profile is fully populated with photos, service list, hours, and Q&A. This is required for Gemini and AI Overview to surface the clinic in local queries.

checklist_items.title: Launch a Google Review Solicitation Campaign
checklist_items.description: Send follow-up emails to recent patients with a direct link to leave a Google review. Target 50+ reviews with specific treatment mentions within 90 days.

checklist_items.title: Build and Publish a Dedicated FAQ Page with FAQPage Schema
checklist_items.description: Create a standalone FAQ page covering common patient questions. Add FAQPage JSON-LD schema so Perplexity and AI Overview can extract and cite individual answers.

checklist_items.title: Claim Healthgrades and WebMD Provider Directory Listings
checklist_items.description: Create or claim profiles on Healthgrades and WebMD's provider directory. Fully complete all fields including specialties, conditions treated, and insurance accepted.

checklist_items.title: Configure AIRT Tracking Prompts
checklist_items.description: Set up at least 10 tracked prompts covering local physical therapy queries, condition-specific queries, and service-specific queries to establish a citation baseline.

checklist_items.title: Create Condition-Specific Service Landing Pages
checklist_items.description: Build individual pages for top conditions: herniated disc, post-surgical rehab, TMJ, sports injuries, and aquatic therapy. Each page should include symptoms, treatment approach, and expected outcomes.

checklist_items.title: Publish First AI-Optimized Blog Post
checklist_items.description: Write and publish a 1,000+ word article on a comparison topic (e.g., 'Aquatic Therapy vs. Traditional PT') or a condition guide. Include structured headers, FAQ section, and internal links to service pages.
